newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Share trade to resume in Portugal's Lisnave.
newsitem.headline: Share trade to resume in Portugal's Lisnave.

text.p: Share trade resumes on Friday in Portuguese ship repairer Lisnave after the company gave more details about its restructuring plan, dealers said.
The stock had been suspended on February 10 at 417 escudos.
The company announced that it plans to set up a new operating company for the ship repair business which will absorb only part of the workforce currently on its books.
The remainder of the workers will become employees of a 'human resources' company in which the Portuguese state will hold a stake of up to 100 percent.
Final details of the restructuring plan are still being negotiated with the Mello Group, the struggling shipyard's principal shareholder.
